assess_post.content: Florida election worker goes public with alleged voter fraud happening right now, per a local news report.

response.answer:
**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post closely mirrors [T4-004732](#T4-004732), which carries the near-identical headline "Florida Election Worker Goes Public With Massive Voter Fraud Happening Right Now," differing mainly in the new post's explicit attribution to "a local news report" and omission of the word "Massive" and the source handle. Both frame the allegation as ongoing ("right now") and attribute it to a Florida election worker going public, rather than asserting fraud as established fact. Other retrieved posts share the broader voter-fraud theme but differ in specifics: [T4-004478](#T4-004478) asserts fraud is "proven" with figures like "18 Million Invalid Registrations, 2 Million dead" and urges retweets, while [T4-003890](#T4-003890) targets Hillary campaign workers in Nevada rather than Florida. [T4-004744](#T4-004744) and [T4-008246](#T4-008246) touch on election results and media criticism respectively but share no specific claim with the new post.
